title: About
text:
STUDENT / 001 LTC



ABOUT THE CARTOGRAPHER


Hello, I’m Le Truong Chinh.
I am studying ISSS626: Geospatial Analytics and Applications at Singapore Management University under the guidance of Prof Kam Tin Seong.
This website is my place to learn in public: to turn spatial data into careful questions, reproducible analysis, and maps that communicate honestly.





01 / PURPOSE ## Why this site exists
GIS is more than placing data on a map. I will use this notebook to document how location, distance, neighbourhood, connectivity, and scale change the way a problem is understood.


02 / TOOLKIT ## How it is built
The site is authored with Quarto, styled as a custom digital atlas, and prepared for deployment on Netlify. Analytical entries can later combine prose, R code, spatial data, and interactive outputs in one reproducible document.


03 / PRINCIPLE ## What belongs here
Only my own coursework, reflections, and analysis will be published. Course materials remain on the official course site; this notebook will link to them where context is needed rather than duplicate them.


04 / REFERENCES ## Source points
